// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  // A_s is populated once per unique i0; cache the last staged i0 to
  // avoid redundant memcpy when j0 advances but i0 repeats the same row-block.
  int last_i0_staged = -1;

  // Invert loop order: j0 outer (B scales hoisted), i0 inner.
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;

    // Stage B scales once per j0 column-block (B scales are independent of i0).
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      // Stage A scales only when i0 changes (A scales are independent of j0).
      if (i0 != last_i0_staged) {
        for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
          memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        last_i0_staged = i0;
      }

      int tiles = BLK / DIM, tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 128;
      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Programming model sequence must be strictly followed:
      // 1. config_ex
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                   1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

      // 2. Load A scales (sel=0) then B scales (sel=1) — both required before compute.
      //    A_s staging was done once per unique i0 above (memcpy eliminated for
      //    repeated i0 across j0); B_s staging was done once per j0 above.
      //    The hardware gemmini_mx_load_scales calls must still be issued every
      //    iteration to satisfy the programming model ordering constraint.
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // 3. MVIN A tiles into scratchpad (stride = full K row width in bytes).
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
              a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // 4. MVIN B tiles into scratchpad (stride = full N row width in bytes).
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
              b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // 5. Configure requantized mvout — i_bound/j_bound/k_bound must match
      //    the tile dimensions passed to gemmini_loop_ws_spad below.
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                    tiles, tiles, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // 6. Fused hardware weight-stationary tiled matmul over the scratchpad.
      //    gemmini_loop_ws_spad internally re-issues funct 24 (LOOP_WS_CONFIG_SPAD_AB)
      //    each time the macro is expanded, satisfying the one-shot mx_loop_spad_marker
      //    requirement.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                            a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                            false, false, false, false, false,
                            NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // 7. Drain BF16-packed results from mx_smem to DRAM, then fence.
      //    Single bulk read covers all mrows*ncols elements in one instruction,
      //    eliminating the per-row loop from the baseline.
      gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                            SPAD_DEST * 16, mrows * ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
